description: One entry of the storage-uri index: the file `projections/storage-uri/<ab>/<cd>/<sha256 of the URI, hex>.json` under the state directory. It answers which resource's content is at a place in the working tree. Written as JSON indented by two spaces, `uri` first.

uri.description: The `file://` URI of a place in the working tree, relative to the knowledge base's root.
